# Fixture policy

No filing or receipt fixtures are included in the scaffold. Future fixtures
must be synthetic and constructed independently from public specifications.
Never derive fixtures from client dossiers or ignored private material.

Synthetic fixtures contributed here are released under [CC0](LICENSE).
Official XSDs, stylesheets, and vendor examples are third-party materials;
the fixture license does not apply to them. Redistribution requires a
documented review of their actual terms.
